text:
maria_ops: APAC alert — ap-northeast-1 GPU pool at 92% utilization, queuing tokens for >800ms. Seen sustained spike for 18m. Suspect one customer training-heavy workload hitting many dedicated pods.

alex_oncall: Ack. Observed increased OOM evictions on p4x. Any automatic fallback triggered?

jay_sre: Fallback tried, but capacity exhausted in region. Autoscaler is throttled due to budget guardrails. We should apply emergency per-customer rate limits and start traffic shifting to eu-west-1 for non-data-residency customers.

maria_ops: Agreed. Proposal: set per-customer qps cap to 15 rps in ap-northeast-1, enable routing policy to prefer eu-west-1 for compatible tenants, and bump reserved capacity for critical customers.

tanya_prod: Need to surface this to customers — especially ones on Dedicated. @kevin_cs please prepare a short blurb. Also ensure we don't break any regional compliance opt-ins.

kevin_cs: On it. Draft: "We're applying temporary throughput limits in ap-northeast-1 to maintain platform stability. If you have region-specific constraints, reply and we'll keep you pinned." Will share in 5.

sam_sales: Heads up — a couple of enterprise customers have live demos in APAC. Can we whitelist a small list to avoid throttling demo traffic? 3 tenants max.

jay_sre: Yes, we can whitelist up to 3 tenant IDs. PM me the IDs and I'll add to allowlist for the 30m window.

alex_oncall: I'll run the commands. Using internal quota API — will patch and then call routing change. Commands:
```
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/quotas/set \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $INFRATOK" \
  -d '{"region":"ap-northeast-1","policy":"per_customer","qps":15,"duration":"30m"}'

# then enable routing
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/routing/update \
  -d '{"region":"ap-northeast-1","fallback_region":"eu-west-1","criteria":"non_residency"}'
```

deploy-bot: quota-change: success — ap-northeast-1 per-customer qps set to 15 (change_id=chg_20240315_09a7)

infra-bot: metrics: ap-northeast-1 request rate dropped 28% in 90s, GPU queue latency reducing. Eviction rate falling.

maria_ops: Great. Jay, can you also lift autoscaler guardrails temporarily to allow one-shot scale until stabilization? We can enforce cost cap afterwards.

jay_sre: Doing it now. Temporarily bumped cap by +30% for 20m. Watching cluster metrics.

kevin_cs: Customer message posted to status page and a short DM to affected enterprise tenants. cc @sam_sales

sam_sales: Thanks — also loop in legal for any compliance notes about cross-region failover.

jay_sre: Noted. If fallback traffic crosses to eu-west-1, make sure KMS key access aligns. I've added fallback KMS key mapping for the non-residency group.

maria_ops: Keep monitoring. If latency still >500ms after 10m, we'll expand throttles to 10 rps and invoke mandatory draining of best-effort jobs.

alex_oncall: Monitoring dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/apn1-gpu-ops — watch `gpu.queue_ms` and `evictions`.

maria_ops: Thanks team. Post-incident: we need a retro for autoscaler budget rules and dataset-heavy tenant detection. Filing follow-up tickets.

kevin_cs: Noted — I'll collect impacted tenant list and any customer comms. Will update here when done.
